# One set of books for every marketplace you sell on.

> Free private tool for resellers: drop your eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Whatnot and Shopify reports and get one monthly profit and loss, what each channel really keeps, and a Schedule C style worksheet. Add a mileage log CSV and sourcing and post office trips go on Schedule C line 9 at the IRS standard mileage rate for each trip's date (72.5 cents to June 30 2026, 76 cents from July 1 2026). Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
